fact: In 2024 UNDP supported the development, deployment and operation of a digital birth registration platform, run in its pilot phase at the Golfe 3 town hall, and the digitalisation of the civil status centres of the 16 communes of the Savanes region, which it says can now issue acts in real time and are trained to use the platform; the Golfe 3 tele-declaration of births had UNDP's technical and financial support.
title: Rapport annuel 2024 Togo
publisher: Programme des Nations Unies pour le développement (PNUD) Togo
